attempts.architecture: 59,812-parameter order-2 molecular PPGN with learned feature-channel matrix products, invariant graph pooling, and four standardized regression heads.
attempts.augmentations: Deterministic distance-derived molecular graphs, target standardization, quadratic-free ablation, and permutation-augmented C6-versus-two-triangles expressivity training.
attempts.description: Reference pipeline trained both molecular regressors for 30 epochs on one Modal L4 during Harbor oracle job ppgn-qm9-oracle-v7; all nine task-specific criteria, all primary metrics, and all critical milestones passed with Binary Grade 1, reward 1.0, and rubric 1.0.
